type.description: Use doc, article, or page. The project value is accepted only for legacy content compatibility.

category.description: One optional Article archive category. Empty means uncategorized. A category is an archive dimension only: it is not a route directory, column, tree or navigation level, and it never changes an Article URL. Only type: article content enters category archives.

tags.description: Zero or more topic labels. Only type: article content enters tag archives.
